en: Transposition estimates irradiance on each module plane using the saved roof and mounting orientation. Transmission factors are the percentage retained: 98% means a 2% reduction. Ground reflectance is a reflected fraction.
final_en: Transposition estimates irradiance on each module plane using the saved roof and mounting orientation. Ground reflectance is the share reflected by the ground. The remaining percentage factors describe the share retained: 98% means a 2% reduction.

en: SAPM uses plane irradiance, air temperature and wind at 10 m. Its a, b and ΔT coefficients depend on module construction and mounting. This form applies no mounting preset.
final_en: SAPM estimates cell temperature from plane-of-array irradiance, air temperature and wind speed at 10 m. Its a, b and ΔT coefficients depend on module construction and mounting; ΔT is specified at 1000 W/m². No mounting preset is applied.
